text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Transcend and Wonder Acute talking in front of some cutting-edge audio equipment.

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI Voice
text_block_list.text: "—Shall I play a playlist from your smartphone?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, no, I don't really have one of those smart-phones, you see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, you see... Something came up and I've gotta learn how to use this machine here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Soon, the neighborhood elders are hosting an event to teach traditional games to the grandkids.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So we decided it'd be nice to play some songs the kids would enjoy... but none of us know what's popular, let alone how to work these gadgets.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And since I'm a youngster of the modern era, they all picked me for the job...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But operating it is mighty complicated, you know? Tran-san just told me it comes with an 'Assistant AI', but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, it doesn't always work like a real conversation. Let's try resetting and starting over once.

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "Please ask me anything."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Aha. Anything, is it? Well then, first off... where might your hometown be?

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "Would you like to change the language? You can choose from ten available languages."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My, you can speak that many? You're quite a clever one, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "I am sorry. The 'San' dialect of the 'Clever' language is not currently supported."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Guess it's pretty tough after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: No worries, no worries. We speak the same language. We'll get to understand each other little by little.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mr. AI. Let's have lots of chats and become a fine pair, alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later. Wonder Acute invited me along, so I headed over to the event—

text_block_list.name: MC Old Man
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then. Next up, we'll be playin' beanbags!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm. When it comes to beanbags, rhythm is key. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mr. AI. Could you put on a lively song from those shows the little ones watch?

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "You got it, dearie."

text_block_list.name: Participant Child A
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! This song! It's the theme song from the Uma Ranger movie!

text_block_list.name: Participant Child B
text_block_list.text: It really is! "Go, go! Carrot Go-Kart~♪"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There we go, everyone's getting right into the groove. Now, keeping to this rhythm, toss the beanbag—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh~ Look how hyped up the kids are, Accu-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, all credit goes to Mr. AI here. We've become fast friends, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "—Oh my, you know historical drama theme songs too? Aren't you impressive."

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "If you specify a genre, I can also create a new playlist for you."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "A playlist... was that a list of songs, if I recall right?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! In that case, can you put together songs from shows that young children watch?!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Talking with it like that over and over, I slowly figured out the right wavelength and how to phrase things so it'd understand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: By now, we're practically like lifelong partners. Right, Mr. AI?

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "Sure are, Accu-san."

text_block_list.text: "Sure are, Accu-san."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Accu-san kept talking to it every single day until she got the hang of it. You've got amazing patience, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, once you take on a task, you see it through. Besides, I gained a new chat partner, so it was actually quite fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment that truly showcased Wonder Acute's persevering spirit—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all. It's just adjusting its tone to make it easier for me to chat. Right, Mr. AI?

text_block_list.name: Assistant AI
text_block_list.text: "Aw, you're exaggeratin' again. I ain't smart enough to think about all that. I'm just talkin' however I please, really."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...If I close my eyes, I honestly don't think I could tell which one of you is talking.
